title: Coefficient augmentation square
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U_i$ any family of opens, $f:F\to G$ an abelian-sheaf morphism, and $I,J$ injective resolutions. For a lift $\varphi:I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$ of $f$, let $T$ be the total map [def-pc-abelian-cech-total-map]. The coefficient augmentations [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction] satisfy $T\circ\beta_I=\beta_J\circ\check C(U,f)$. No covering hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: The total-map summand formula reduces the equality degreewise to the Cech functor applied to the resolution lifting equation iota_I composed with phi^0 equals f composed with iota_J. Use functoriality and cochain morphism extensionality.

lean.statement:
theorem abelianCechBeta_square
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    {F G : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}}
    {I : InjectiveResolution F} {J : InjectiveResolution G} {f : F ⟶ G}
    (φ : InjectiveResolution.Hom I J f) :
    abelianCechBeta U I ≫ abelianCechTotalMap U φ.hom =
      (TopCat.Sheaf.cechComplexFunctor U).map f ≫ abelianCechBeta U J
